rules.component: start_game, StartOptions, deterministic shuffle/opening hand setup, take_mulligan, keep_mulligan_hand, MulliganRecord, MulliganKeepRecord
rules.notes: Covers deck-to-library initialization, configurable opening hand size, deterministic shuffle, life initialization, first active/priority player, and a narrow London-style mulligan scaffold. take_mulligan returns the current hand through ZoneChangeRecord hand-to-library movement, shuffles deterministically, and redraws through DrawRecord. keep_mulligan_hand bottoms cards equal to mulligans_taken through ZoneChangeRecord hand-to-library movement and records MulliganKeepRecord metadata. Sideboarding, companion, and tournament pregame procedures remain out of scope.
rules.title: Starting the game scaffold

rules.component: keep_mulligan_hand, MulliganKeepRecord, hand-to-library bottom placement, typed event spine
rules.notes: Executable London mulligan keep/bottom scaffold: after one or more mulligans, keep_mulligan_hand bottoms a number of chosen cards equal to PlayerState::mulligans_taken, routes each chosen card through move_object hand-to-library movement, deterministically inserts the chosen cards at the library bottom in the supplied order, and records MulliganKeepRecord metadata linked by EventRecordKind::MulliganKeep. Multiplayer mulligan simultaneity and optional additional keep/redo policy remain out of scope.
rules.title: Mulligans: keep hand and bottom cards

rules.notes: Metadata-only keyword/static-ability bucket. rev0012 implements flying, reach, deathtouch, lifelink, and vigilance as selected narrow behaviors. rev0013 adds deterministic first strike, double strike, trample, and indestructible scaffolds. This still does not claim full 702 coverage, duplicated/redundant ability handling beyond bit masks, characteristic/layer interactions, keyword counters, or Oracle-text import. rev0014 adds haste, defender, hexproof, and shroud scaffolds plus source-aware targeting and summoning-sickness gates. rev0015 adds color-protection and menace keyword scaffolds. rev0017 adds an Aura/Equipment attachment metadata scaffold with attachment-granted P/T/ability hooks and state-based attachment cleanup.
rules.title: Keyword abilities inventory

rules.component: AbilityDeathtouch plus deathtouch_damage_marked and SBA lethal check
rules.notes: Any positive damage from a deathtouch source to a battlefield creature marks a deathtouch lethal flag until cleanup/zone change/SBA. rev0013 confirms indestructible ignores the deathtouch destroy-style SBA while non-positive toughness still moves the creature to the graveyard. Does not model full last-known information, protection, damage assignment choices, or all deathtouch/trample edge cases. rev0047 adds DamageRecord structured damage records that snapshot source/target identities and requested/prevented/dealt quantities for prevention, protection, lifelink, and deathtouch auditability. rev0176 proves deathtouch metadata is not applied when the target-type gate records all requested damage as not_dealt.
rules.title: Deathtouch scaffold

rules.component: AbilityDefender, can_declare_attacker, validation combat.defender_attacking
rules.notes: Creatures with defender are filtered out of declare-attacker legality and illegal attacker metadata is rejected by validation. Effects that remove/grant defender dynamically are not implemented beyond direct ability-mask metadata.
rules.title: Defender scaffold

rules.component: KeywordAbilityMask::AbilityDoubleStrike, split combat-damage batches
rules.notes: A creature with double strike assigns damage in both the first-strike and regular combat-damage batches when assign_combat_damage sees a split combat-damage step. This does not model all damage-step priority windows, layer-granted abilities, damage order choices, or noncombat damage interactions.
rules.title: Double strike scaffold

rules.component: KeywordAbilityMask::AbilityFirstStrike, first-strike combat-damage batch
rules.notes: A creature with first strike assigns damage in a first-strike batch before ordinary combat damage; SBAs run between the first and regular batches in this scaffold. Missing priority windows, ability changes between batches, damage order choices, and all edge cases around combat-phase mutations. A regression test also verifies that a nonlethal first-strike hit does not suppress surviving ordinary blockers from dealing regular combat damage.
rules.title: First strike scaffold

rules.component: KeywordAbilityMask::AbilityFlash, can_cast_spell_now
rules.notes: Flash is represented as a keyword/static permission bit that lets a noninstant card use instant timing. Full continuous addition/removal of flash remains roadmap.
rules.title: Flash timing scaffold

rules.component: AbilityFlying plus can_block_attacker_by_evasion
rules.notes: Flying attackers can only be blocked by creatures with flying or reach in the current one-blocker action scaffold. Does not implement other evasion/protection/restriction effects.
rules.title: Flying scaffold

rules.component: AbilityHaste, object_has_summoning_sickness, attack/tap-mana legality
rules.notes: Haste bypasses the current summoning-sickness gate for attacking and activating built-in creature tap-mana abilities. It does not yet cover untap-symbol ability costs or dynamic continuous effects that grant/remove haste.
rules.title: Haste scaffold

rules.component: AbilityHexproof, target_ref_is_legal_for_source, source-aware target enumeration and resolution checks
rules.notes: Permanents with hexproof cannot be chosen as targets by opposing source controllers in the current target-action and resolution scaffold. Player hexproof, hexproof-from qualities, layer-added abilities, and non-target interactions are not implemented.
rules.title: Hexproof scaffold

rules.component: KeywordAbilityMask::AbilityIndestructible, SBA lethal/deathtouch damage bypass
rules.notes: A creature with indestructible is not moved to the graveyard by lethal marked damage or deathtouch lethal damage in apply_state_based_actions. Non-positive toughness still moves it to the graveyard. Missing destroy effects, regeneration, damage-removal timing beyond cleanup, layer-granted/removing indestructible, and replacement/prevention interactions.
rules.title: Indestructible scaffold

rules.component: AbilityLifelink hook in deal_damage_to_target, lifelink damage-life result backlinks
rules.notes: Damage dealt by a source with lifelink causes its current controller to gain that much life. This does not yet model last-known information, owner fallback for no controller, damage batches with simultaneous events, or replacement effects beyond the existing simple prevention shield. rev0047 adds DamageRecord structured damage records that snapshot source/target identities and requested/prevented/dealt quantities for prevention, protection, lifelink, and deathtouch auditability. rev0176 proves lifelink gains no life when the target-type gate records all requested damage as not_dealt. rev0178 links lifelink gain rows to the owning DamageRecord with source-controller, source-zone, target, and amount validation.
rules.title: Lifelink scaffold

rules.component: CardDefinition::protection_color_mask, target_has_protection_from_source, damage prevention, block legality validation
rules.notes: rev0015 implements only protection from color for battlefield objects: protected objects cannot be targeted by sources with overlapping source colors, damage from such sources is prevented, and attacking protected creatures cannot be blocked by creatures of the protected color. It does not implement protection from non-color qualities, Aura/Equipment/Fortification attachment rules, player protection, complete trample/protection damage assignment, layer-granted protection, or Oracle-derived protection text. rev0034 adds a self-dies red trigger fixture proving source color snapshots prevent a red protected object from being selected after the source has moved to the graveyard. rev0047 adds DamageRecord structured damage records that snapshot source/target identities and requested/prevented/dealt quantities for prevention, protection, lifelink, and deathtouch auditability.
rules.title: Protection from color scaffold

rules.component: AbilityReach plus can_block_attacker_by_evasion
rules.notes: Reach allows the current blocker declaration scaffold to block a flying attacker. Other reach interactions are currently just static ability metadata.
rules.title: Reach scaffold

rules.component: AbilityShroud, target_ref_is_legal_for_source and source-aware target enumeration
rules.notes: Permanents with shroud are filtered from targeted spell/action choices regardless of source controller. Player shroud, dynamic ability grants/removals, and effects that do not target remain outside this scaffold.
rules.title: Shroud scaffold

rules.component: KeywordAbilityMask::AbilityTrample, deterministic excess combat-damage assignment
rules.notes: A trampling attacker assigns deterministic lethal damage to blockers in object-id order, then assigns excess combat damage to the defending player. If all blockers have left combat, blocked-attacker memory allows a trampler to assign all damage to the defending player. Missing player-selected damage order, planeswalkers/battles, assignment choices, protection, prevention-order edge cases, and full deathtouch/trample detail. rev0053 records trample lethal-to-blocker and excess-to-defender routing as CombatDamageAssignmentRecord entries linked to DamageRecord.
rules.title: Trample scaffold

rules.component: AbilityVigilance hook in declare_attacker, CombatDeclarationRecord vigilance tap snapshot
rules.notes: A vigilant attacker is not tapped by the current declare-attacker scaffold. This does not yet model summoning sickness, attack requirements/restrictions, or layer/continuous-effect grants/removals of vigilance. rev0054 records vigilance tap-state behavior in CombatDeclarationRecord so the no-tap result is auditable.
rules.title: Vigilance scaffold

rules.component: KeywordAbilityMask::AbilityMenace plus batch blocker declaration helper and validation, CombatDeclarationRecord menace batch snapshot
rules.notes: rev0015 models menace as a combat-evasion check requiring at least two blockers in the final declaration batch. The ordinary one-blocker action enumerator intentionally omits single menace blocks; a new batch helper/scenario command can commit a legal two-blocker declaration. This does not implement all block restrictions/requirements, blocking-order choices, multiplayer attack options, or effects that change legality during blocker declaration. rev0054 records the blocker batch size and final blocker count in CombatDeclarationRecord so menace satisfaction is auditable without parsing event strings.
rules.title: Menace scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions pass-barrier candidate collection, player-loss checks, lethal creature damage/toughness scaffold, +1/+1 and -1/-1 counter pair cancellation, deathtouch lethal-damage flag, typed StateBasedActionRecord stream with check/pass evidence
rules.notes: Current behavior covers life <= 0, poison >= 10, empty-library draw attempt loss, and creature lethal-damage/non-positive-toughness transfer to owner graveyard. rev0007 verifies that targeted damage can feed the lethal-damage SBA path. Many other state-based actions remain roadmap. rev0008 confirms lethal combat damage feeds the same SBA path. rev0009 verifies that SBA-driven creature death can queue a simple dies trigger. rev0011 adds pairwise +1/+1/-1/-1 counter cancellation before toughness/death checks. rev0012 adds a deathtouch-lethal flag checked alongside ordinary lethal damage in the creature-death SBA scaffold. rev0013 adds the indestructible exception for lethal/deathtouch destroy-style damage while preserving non-positive-toughness graveyard movement. rev0015 validation catches underblocked menace and protection-illegal block metadata. rev0016 splits non-positive-toughness graveyard movement from lethal/deathtouch destroy-style SBAs so regeneration can replace only the destroy paths. rev0017 adds an Aura/Equipment attachment metadata scaffold with attachment-granted P/T/ability hooks and state-based attachment cleanup. rev0018 adds token-ceased-to-exist cleanup for tokens that have left the battlefield. rev0020 adds zero-defense battle state-based cleanup. rev0046 adds an SBA-driven regression that proves lethal-damage movement through replacement emits a valid structured zone-change record. rev0052 adds StateBasedActionRecord and EventRecordKind::StateBasedAction so SBA outcomes are auditable without parsing event strings. rev0175 adds a simultaneous SBA creature-death LKI regression proving cross-dies triggers use a pre-batch battlefield snapshot instead of per-object post-move trigger-source capture. rev0185 changes SBA execution to collect candidates at each check-pass boundary, adds check_index/pass_index/pass_candidate_count evidence, and moves Aura cleanup created by lethal creature death into the repeated check rather than hidden zone-change cleanup.
rules.title: State-based actions scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions pass-barrier loop, pre_creature_sba_ltb_snapshots, StateBasedActionRecord-linked movements with check_index/pass_index/pass_candidate_count
rules.notes: Narrow tested scaffold for the simultaneous-perform aspect of state-based actions. rev0175 keeps creature lethal-damage and nonpositive-toughness movements internally sequential for records, but derives LTB trigger-source discovery from one pre-SBA batch snapshot so simultaneous creature deaths do not lose cross-object dies triggers. This does not yet generalize to every SBA kind or expose a full event-batch object. rev0185 makes the repeated-check structure explicit: candidates are collected before a pass is applied, newly-created conditions wait until the next pass, and validation scopes pass monotonicity within a check_index instead of globally.
rules.title: Simultaneous state-based action batch scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions token cleanup via GameObject::ceased_to_exist and zone-container erasure
rules.notes: Covers the narrow SBA that a token in a zone other than the battlefield ceases to exist: MTGSim preserves the object record with a ceased flag for deterministic debugging while removing it from zone containers. It does not yet model every token-copy/object history nuance or all interactions with delayed triggers and linked abilities.
rules.title: Token ceased-to-exist SBA scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions moves creatures with effective toughness <= 0 to owner graveyard without regeneration replacement
rules.notes: Only creature toughness <= 0 is covered; the wider SBA set remains incomplete. rev0025 confirms static P/T modifiers feed this SBA through effective_toughness. rev0052 shares the typed SBA record infrastructure used by toughness and damage-removal paths, preserving the distinction that non-positive toughness is not regenerated.
rules.title: Non-positive toughness SBA scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions detects lethal marked damage and routes destruction through destroy_permanent so regeneration can replace it
rules.notes: No full damage-assignment order, prevention/replacement ordering, or all creature modifiers are implemented. rev0052 records lethal-damage destroy SBAs as StateBasedActionKind::CreatureDamageDestroy, including regeneration shield snapshots and linked zone-change records when the permanent actually leaves. rev0175 adds a simultaneous SBA creature-death LKI regression proving cross-dies triggers use a pre-batch battlefield snapshot instead of per-object post-move trigger-source capture.
rules.title: Lethal damage destroy SBA scaffold

rules.component: deathtouch_damage_marked feeds the same destroy_permanent path as lethal damage, with indestructible and regeneration hooks
rules.notes: Only a simple flag is modeled; full source characteristics, timestamps, and damage history remain roadmap. rev0052 keeps deathtouch-damage SBA routing through the typed damage-destroy record path.
rules.title: Deathtouch damage destroy SBA scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions zero-loyalty planeswalker movement
rules.notes: Covers moving a battlefield planeswalker with zero loyalty counters to its owner's graveyard. Replacement effects and full planeswalker edge cases remain roadmap. rev0177 does not change the zero-loyalty SBA itself, but it ensures the preceding damage-caused loyalty removal receipt is linked to the DamageRecord that caused it.
rules.title: Zero-loyalty planeswalker SBA scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions Aura attachment cleanup
rules.notes: Covers moving unattached or illegally attached Aura permanents to owner graveyard. It does not yet model all Aura exceptions such as bestow-specific behavior. rev0185 proves an Aura made unattached by its enchanted creature dying is moved by the repeated SBA pass, not by direct zone-change helper cleanup.
rules.title: Unattached/illegal Aura SBA scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions Equipment/Fortification unattach cleanup
rules.notes: Covers detaching illegal Equipment/Fortification attachments while leaving the object on the battlefield. Full Fortification and reconfigure behavior remains roadmap. rev0185 keeps Equipment/Fortification detachment separate from Aura graveyard cleanup at the pass barrier.
rules.title: Illegal Equipment/Fortification SBA scaffold

rules.component: apply_state_based_actions battle zero-defense movement
rules.notes: Covers zero-defense battle movement to owner graveyard. Does not yet model the exception for battles that are the source of an unresolved triggered ability. rev0177 does not change the zero-defense SBA itself, but it ensures the preceding damage-caused defense removal receipt is linked to the DamageRecord that caused it.
rules.title: Battle zero-defense SBA scaffold

rules.component: core.copy rule module, copy metadata and validation
rules.notes: Tracks copy-effect rules as a dedicated module. This is a narrow battlefield permanent copy scaffold, not complete copying of objects/spells/cards/tokens.
rules.title: Copying objects inventory scaffold

rules.component: become_copy_of_permanent snapshots source copiable definition index
rules.notes: Current scaffold copies the source permanent current copiable definition index and projects derived characteristics from that definition. It intentionally excludes full printed/copied value exceptions, face status, token copy details, and copy-modifying text.
rules.title: Copiable values snapshot scaffold

rules.component: copied_definition_index snapshot and validation cleanup
rules.notes: Covers the important snapshot behavior that later changes to the original source do not alter an existing copy in this definition-index scaffold.
rules.title: Copied information independence scaffold

rules.component: N-player turn order skeleton, next_player_in_turn_order
rules.notes: Only alive-player cycling is tested. Team/range/attack-option/variant multiplayer rules are not implemented.
rules.title: Multiplayer rules inventory

rules.component: future.formats rule module placeholder, format modules
rules.notes: Commander, Planechase, Archenemy, Vanguard, and other variants will live behind format modules. rev0003 only tracks the future module boundary.
rules.title: Casual variants inventory

rules.component: rules_parser, term index
rules.notes: Future parser should link glossary terms to engine concepts and oracle text parser output.
rules.title: Terms and definitions inventory

rules.component: move_spell_card_to_stack_for_cast, finish_paid_cast_after_costs, StackPlacementRecord::priority_after, activate_activated_ability_with_targets, activate_loyalty_ability_with_targets, PriorityTransitionRecord::priority_before/priority_after
rules.notes: rev0055 records and validates that the acting controller retains priority after casting a spell or activating an ability; opponents act only after that player passes. rev0056 extends that fix through the pass chain: pass-priority records prove when priority advances, when all players passed to resolve the stack, and when empty-stack passes advance the step.
rules.title: Priority after casting or activating

rules.component: StackPlacementRecord for spell casts, cast_from_hand_to_stack_paying_mana*
rules.notes: rev0055 snapshots the completed spell placement on the stack after costs/modes/targets are fixed, including stack zone-change linkage and priority_after.
rules.title: Spell becomes cast after casting process

rules.component: CLI replay artifact path for deterministic StateCoreSnapshot.v1 plus ActionTrace.v1 verification.
rules.notes: Project-local replay seam under rule 117/determinism tracking: the CLI can write a demo snapshot/trace pair, parse both files, replay from the reconstructed snapshot, and fail on parse or replay divergence before claiming artifact validity.

rules.component: ReplayArtifactManifest.v3 binds persisted StateCoreSnapshot.v1 and ActionTrace.v16 artifacts to checkpoint metadata, manifest_schema evidence, expected final StateCore hash, and optional paid-action journal attachment evidence; ReplayArtifactManifest.v2 remains a historical/backcompat manifest schema.
rules.notes: rev0076 turns the two-file replay pair into a manifest-bound bundle. rev0114 promotes the text artifact to ReplayArtifactManifest.v2, adds manifest_schema evidence, includes the schema in bundle_hash, and reports ManifestSchemaMismatch before snapshot parsing or trace replay when a bundle declares an unsupported manifest schema. rev0170 promotes the manifest to ReplayArtifactManifest.v3, adds explicit paid-action journal attachment fields, binds PaidActionTransactionJournal.v3 text/state/journal/payload hashes into bundle_hash, and makes attached bundles fail closed with PaidActionJournalMissing when the journal is omitted.

rules.component: ReplayArtifactFailureKind and CLI replay bundle inspection diagnostics for manifest-bound StateCoreSnapshot.v1 plus ActionTrace.v1 bundles.
rules.notes: rev0077 adds typed failure classification and expected/actual diagnostic fields for snapshot hash, trace hash, checkpoint seal, action-count mismatch, replay-step divergence, and final StateCore mismatch. The mtgsim_cli_replay_bundle_inspect_roundtrip CTest keeps the inspect path executable from disk artifacts.

rules.component: ReplayArtifactPrefixResult and CLI replay prefix artifacts for manifest-bound failure localization.
rules.notes: rev0078 adds make_replay_artifact_prefix_bundle and mtgsim_cli --write-replay-prefix. Replay-step failures produce the longest known-good prefix plus next_bad_step; final-StateCore mismatches normalize to a full replay-good prefix with a fresh manifest.

rules.component: ReplayArtifactResumeResult and CLI replay resume-probe artifacts for manifest-bound transition isolation.
rules.notes: rev0079 adds make_replay_artifact_resume_probe and mtgsim_cli --write-replay-resume-probe. Replay-step failures write a fresh snapshot at the longest known-good prefix and a suffix trace/manifest so the suspect transition becomes suffix step one; verified bundles write an empty suffix from the final StateCore snapshot.

rules.component: StateCheckpointSeal.v2, kStateCheckpointSealSchemaVersion, checkpoint_schema text evidence, CheckpointSchemaMismatch replay guard, checkpoint snapshot reader cleanup
rules.notes: rev0115 makes the standalone replay checkpoint seal self-describing. Fresh checkpoint seal text uses MTGSim.StateCheckpointSeal.v2 with checkpoint_schema=2, historical v1 seals remain parseable as schema version 1, and replay_action_trace_from_checkpoint rejects unsupported checkpoint schemas before checking checkpoint hashes or applying trace actions.

rules.component: apnap_ordered_players, ChoiceRequestQueue APNAP choice-order hash, ordered choice request replay guard, ChoiceQueueLocation.v1 APNAP queue-entry hash seal and queue proof checked/found sentinels and explicit queue-location schema evidence, ChoiceRequestQueue schema_version evidence, ActionTrace.v15 choice_queue_schema replay guard
rules.notes: rev0081 adds executable APNAP ordering for choice request queues without bundling official rule text. rev0082 clarifies that the current APNAP-ordered queue is a replay guard and ordering scaffold, not a transaction-specific implementation of simultaneous choices under rule 101.4. rev0107 adds ChoiceQueueLocation.v1 and choice_queue_location_hash evidence so queue hash/index/size, selected request metadata, and selected action hash cannot drift independently in replay artifacts. rev0108 adds explicit queue proof checked/found sentinels so zero/nonzero hashes no longer collapse absence of proof with negative proof. rev0109 adds choice_queue_schema evidence to the queue-location proof so the APNAP queue proof protocol version is visible outside the compact hash. rev0112 exposes kChoiceRequestQueueSchemaVersion through ChoiceRequestQueue, ActionReceiptRecord, ActionTrace.v15 choice_queue_schema evidence, validation, and replay diagnostics so APNAP choice-queue schema drift is rejected before mutation. rev0172 applies the APNAP scaffold directly to pending-trigger placement: trigger_order choices may permute a player-controlled block but cannot reorder across APNAP player blocks.
rules.title: General APNAP ordering scaffold

rules.component: apnap_ordered_players, PendingTriggersToStack choice generation, trigger_order APNAP-block validator, ActionTrace.v17 trigger_order evidence
rules.notes: Local metadata row for the APNAP choice-order seam used by pending triggered abilities. It does not bundle official rules text. rev0172 models the relevant ordering surface narrowly: each pending trigger is named by TriggerRecord index, same-controller blocks can be ordered by action selection, and cross-APNAP block reordering is rejected.
rules.title: APNAP simultaneous trigger-order choice scaffold

rules.component: OrderCombatDamage public action, ChoiceRequest gate, GameObject::combat_damage_ordered_blockers, bounded damage-order frontier completeness and direct omitted-order validation
rules.notes: rev0092 adds a required active-player choice for ordering blockers of a multi-blocked attacker before ordinary priority resumes. This is a narrow tested scaffold and does not claim banding or all damage-order variants. rev0095 reports that six-blocker permutation enumeration is incomplete at the 128-action budget and directly validates/replays a legal omitted order. Prefix paging and banding remain open. rev0096 keeps direct-domain validation source durable in receipts/traces for omitted bounded-frontier combat choices. rev0097 adds cursor paging for combat-damage order permutations, proving a six-blocker tail page reaches late legal orders beyond the 128-action frontier prefix. rev0098 adds page-location evidence for late combat-damage order permutations beyond the first 128-action prefix. rev0099 keeps late combat-damage order page locations replay-checkable through ActionTrace.v3. rev0102 keeps combat choice paging aligned by sharing the same attack/block/damage-order emitters between bounded frontiers and cursor pages.
rules.title: Combat damage assignment order choice scaffold

rules.component: ordered_blockers_for_combat_damage, assign_combat_damage, CombatDamageAssignmentRecord
rules.notes: rev0092 verifies that a chosen multi-blocker order controls lethal-first trample assignment and assignment-record target order. This remains a scaffold for the common single-attacker case.
rules.title: Trample assignment follows chosen blocker order

rules.component: tools/run_fuzz.py failure replay, binary-searched minimal failing step count, JUnit/JSON repro commands, tools/harness.py python.fuzz_runner guard, audit_fuzz_wiring probes
rules.notes: Synthetic MTGSim control-flow ledger anchor for the randomized legal-action harness. rev0182 does not claim a Wizards rules number; it hardens the rules-testing feedback loop by replaying each failed seed, binary-searching the smallest failing --steps value, and writing the minimal repro command into JSON/JUnit reports. This follows the same practical risk principle as public fuzzing minimizers: failures should be reproducible and reduced before humans debug them.
rules.title: Fuzz failure replay and shrinking harness
